color.summary: Black and white: #000000 ink on a #ffffff page, #757575 for secondary text, #cccccc for faint lines and #f7f7f7 (ZDS's background-low) behind product images. Primary buttons are black with white text, #363636 on hover. The one accent is pink #df1995, on the rows the menu drawer highlights. Focus is blue #0170e9: a 2px ring 2px off buttons and links, a 2px bottom line on fields. ZDS also ships danger #e90d01, success #0a882a and warning #b66009; the census saw the red and the orange only as text in the navigation.
missing: Light only: the web store has no dark theme. ZDS ships a .zds-theme--dark set that only the native apps' webviews use.

type.summary: Helvetica Now Text, almost all at 300: 11px on 16px for product names and the footer, 12px for copy and search fields, 13px for buttons and the login's field, 15px on 20px for the menu drawer's rows. Buttons, links, tabs and headings are capitals by text-transform with no added tracking; the current item steps to 500 with 0.8px tracking. The menu drawer's WOMAN, MAN and KIDS tabs are the one exception: Times New Roman at 28px and 400 with -1.5px tracking.

shape.summary: Square: buttons, fields, dialogs and the menu drawer have no corner radius. The only round shapes are the stores map's controls.

spacing.summary: A 4px grid with 8px the most used step, then 12, 20 and 24. Buttons are 32px with 12px sides (40px for the large secondary), fields 32 to 40px with no side padding. The menu drawer's rows are 36px with 8px sides, the listing side nav's 20px. The region dialog has 20px padding and 20px gaps.

elevation.summary: Flat: the store's own parts have no shadows. Overlays sit on a white wash at 75% with no blur, and the region dialog is set apart by a 1px #cccccc line instead of a shadow. The only drop read is on the stores map's controls (0 1px 4px -1px at 30%).

button.summary: Square, in capitals at 300 with no tracking. ZDS names three variants: primary is black with white text, secondary white in a 1px black line, tertiary-marginless bare text. small is 32px with 12px sides at 13px, large 40px. Icon buttons are bare black glyphs. Focus is a 2px #0170e9 ring 2px out, shown only after a key press.

provenance.notes: Written block by block from the census (spec.json, census 4fcf712) and its frozen copies: 17 pages of the US store in English, light only (home with the region dialog and the menu drawer, two listings, a product page, search, the bag, the login, the account pages, help center, stores, gift card, newsletter), read signed in in Mehdi's research Chrome. Signed-in text is redacted in the copies, so parts were named from their layout, icons and values; the pack's sources.md agrees. Names marked ai are ours; primary, secondary, tertiary-marginless, small, large, m and level-1 are ZDS's class names.
